expect_nodes.name: GET /boards/{board}
expect_nodes.note: [HttpGet] + [Route("boards/{board}")] is ONE route: the template-less verb constrains the template (HQ.2)

expect_nodes.name: POST /api/cards
expect_nodes.note: positive control: bare [HttpPost] with no [Route] of its own inherits the controller template

expect_edges.note: the verb-constrained route is handled by its action
the GET call pairs with the GET route, not by rule any with a verb-less template

forbid.name: GET /
forbid.note: a template-less [HttpGet] beside a [Route] is no route of its own

forbid.name: ANY /boards/{board}
forbid.note: the [Route] beside [HttpGet] carries the GET verb
